purpose: Version 86 packages the corrected IMAGE Transmitter 2 writing-format mapping and records a controlled K-1 II and K-3 III regression campaign against one exact artifact.

changes.summary: Keep IT2 ShootingFormat, WritingFormatSetting, and RawKind as separate code domains; expose JPEG, RAW, and RAW+JPEG for the K-1/K-1 II/K-3 III family, reject unsupported TIFF, and count a companion only for WritingFormatSetting RAW+JPEG.
Preserve model capability gates while keeping K-1 II and K-3 III controls on the source-authorized paths; Monochrome remains separately gated and is not claimed by this candidate.
Require and publish the generated release change manifest so the exact source commits, declared fixes, and artifact hashes travel with version 86.

validation_focus: Verify post-boot FwVer, build identity, ZIP and install-manifest hashes before attaching either camera.
On K-3 III and K-1 II separately, record model identity, current image format, shutter-speed list, ISO list, AF With Live View, focus direction, preview, and one RAW capture.
Exercise RAW-only and RAW+JPEG only when each body advertises that mode; confirm no wait for a file the body did not promise.
Restore every changed camera setting and repeat a safe read-only probe after disconnect/reconnect.
known_limits: This candidate does not claim K-3 III Monochrome qualification.
A two-body controlled test is physical evidence for the recorded scenarios only; it is not libgphoto2-wide or all-mode qualification.
No shutter or capture action is permitted until the running version and camera model are independently verified.
